responsibility: Defines the user-visible and internal command-line options for the FT32 backend and maps them to target masks or variables. These options control simulator targeting, use of LRA, suppression of hardware divide/mod instructions, selection of FT32B and compressed-code features, and whether readable data may be placed in program memory, thereby feeding target flag state used by ft32.cc and ft32.md.
same_name_distinction: Unlike ft32.h, ft32.cc, and ft32.md, this file does not describe hardware semantics or instruction patterns directly; it is the option-specification file that declares FT32-specific command-line switches and binds them to target masks/variables such as SIM, NODIV, FT32B, COMPRESS, NOPM, and ft32_lra_flag used by the other same-stem files.
